app.title: Segmentation Studio: SEM/TEM particle segmentation and size distribution
app.summary: A person sets the model, compute device, pixel size, preprocessing and a size filter in a sidebar, then loads a batch of microscopy images by uploading them or pointing to a folder. They can enhance contrast or downsample the images and check each one against its original side by side, then load a segmentation model and run it on every image. Each detected particle is cut out, measured in physical units and filtered by size. The person looks over each image's mask overlay, particle crops and measurement table, studies size distributions for one image or all of them, and exports per-image and combined measurement tables or a full package of masks, crops, figures and metadata.

task.text: Segment particles in a batch of microscopy images with a pretrained model, measure each particle's size and shape in physical units, and get particle size distributions and measurement tables out.

data.text: A batch of grayscale microscopy images, each turned into a set of per-particle masks and a table of size and shape measurements
data.item: a particle segmented from one microscopy image, with its mask, crop and measurements

stage.text: measuring particles from microscope images after imaging, before reporting size distributions

mechanism.text: Sidebar settings drive a tabbed pipeline (load, preprocess, segment, results, distributions, export), and each tab stays empty until the step before it has run. In the results and distributions tabs, picking an image or the pooled set redraws the mask overlay, crops, tables, histograms and statistics for that selection.

field.text: deep-learning particle segmentation and particle size distribution analysis in electron microscopy

workflow.name: segment objects in a batch of images, measure them, and summarize their size distribution

steps.here: Upload TIF/PNG/JPG/BMP files or browse to a folder. 16-bit and float images are scaled to 8-bit, and a thumbnail grid previews the batch.
CLAHE (clip limit, tile size) and rebinning set in the sidebar are applied to every image, and an original-vs-processed pair can be checked per image

steps.step: compute a value from the data
steps.here: Load a SAM/SAM2/MobileSAM/FastSAM/YOLOv8 checkpoint on CPU, CUDA or MPS and run it. Each mask is cut out and measured for area, axes, equivalent diameter and Feret diameters in nm using the pixel size.

steps.step: filter to the items that matter
steps.here: Particles outside a min/max value of the chosen size metric are dropped from both the masks and the measurements
Pick an image to see its summary statistics, mask overlay with particle IDs, a grid of particle crops and the full measurement table
Size distribution figures and statistics for one image or all images pooled, with x-axis limits, plus a single-property histogram with an adjustable bin count
Download per-image and combined measurement CSVs, or generate a ZIP or save a folder with raw/processed images, masks, per-particle masks, crops, mask metadata and 300 dpi figures

distinctive: pixel measurements are converted to physical units (nm, nm²) from a pixel size entered by the person
the person can swap between several pretrained foundation and segmentation model families and compute devices, and local checkpoints are found automatically or downloaded
minimum Feret diameter is computed from a minimum-area rectangle, alongside max Feret, equivalent diameter and ellipse axes
every preprocessing stage (raw, rebinned, CLAHE, processed) is saved with the results, so the analysis trail can be retraced
figures are rendered at 300 dpi so they can go straight into a publication
